subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

I had a **feeling that I was unable to speak due to sadness** as I watched the casket of the fallen soldier return home.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"lump in the throat"** means a tight feeling in the throat caused by strong emotion, especially sadness. (गले में गाठ )

 
 
• **Example: **She had a** lump in her throat** as she said goodbye to her best friend.
 
 
 
• **"Lump in the throat" **refers to the feeling of being unable to speak due to strong emotion, typically sadness. (गले में गाठ)
 
 
• **Example: **I felt a** lump in my throat** when I heard the sad news.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the dark** (अंधेरे में): Unaware of something.

 
 
• **Example:** I was kept in the dark about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Cut corners** (शॉर्टकट लेना): To do something in the easiest or cheapest way, often sacrificing quality.
 
 
• **Example: **They cut corners to finish the project on time, which resulted in poor quality work.
 
 
 
• **Tongue in cheek** (मजाक में): Not meant to be taken seriously.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were meant to be tongue in cheek, but some people took them seriously.
